route: 4 (a parameter the item text implies: the published PARS-3 scoring formula, checked against the study's own stored total)
evidence: Live table joined per respondent (1033/1033 matched) to the stored physical-activity total in S1 column 74 (mean 42.015, sd 29.779, range 0-100). Paper's formula PA = Intensity x (Duration - 1) x Frequency: item1*(item2-1)*item3 reproduces the stored total EXACTLY for 1033/1033 respondents, versus 406/1033 (39.3%) for duration=item1 and 425/1033 (41.1%) for duration=item3. That pins item2 = duration outright. It does NOT distinguish item1 from item3: the product is commutative, so intensity and frequency are interchangeable in the identity (live means 3.564 and 3.659). item1=intensity / item3=frequency rest on the paper's presentation order alone.
